# TinyExpr

Source: https://github.com/codeplea/tinyexpr

Revision: `ba2e32bbcc2d1e644a7e132d24c2f542821cabe0`

License: zlib; see LICENSE and the notices in the original files.

The tinyexpr.c and tinyexpr.h source files are unchanged. Only trailing blank
lines in LICENSE have been trimmed. This package compiles TinyExpr with
`TE_POW_FROM_RIGHT` and registers the additional `min` and `max` functions
in the UpdateGoal wrapper.
